If you lived, worked, volunteered, or participated in rescue, recovery, or cleanup efforts in the New York City disaster area after September 11, 2001, and have since been diagnosed with certain cancers, you may have legal rights. A free case review can help determine whether you may qualify to pursue compensation related to your diagnosis. There is no obligation to learn more.

Your exposure happened years ago. The effects may only be appearing now.

Many individuals who were exposed to toxic dust and debris developed serious health conditions years later. You may be eligible for a free case review if you:

Worked, Lived, or Attended School in the Area

Worked, lived, attended school, or volunteered in the affected area after September 11, 2001.

Took Part in Rescue, Recovery, or Cleanup

Participated in rescue, recovery, cleanup, or related operations in the disaster area.

Diagnosed With Cancer or a Qualifying Illness

Were later diagnosed with certain types of cancer or another qualifying illness.

Why Contact Us?

Our team helps individuals determine whether they may qualify for a World Trade Center-related cancer claim. We'll review your circumstances, answer your questions, and explain the next steps. All at no cost and with no obligation.

  1. Step 01

    Complete the Short Form or Call

    Tell us a few basic things about your time in the disaster area and your diagnosis. It takes about a minute and costs nothing.

  2. Step 02

    We Review Your Circumstances

    A member of our team reviews your information and reaches out to answer your questions and explain next steps.

  3. Step 03

    Understand Your Options

    If you may qualify, we explain what a claim could involve. There is no cost and no obligation to move forward.
